tasks.title: Per-task grill recorder + schema + storage
tasks.objective: Add a task-keyed grill gate primitive. Extend record_grill_from_json.py with a `task` gate that takes --task <id>, writes .factory/grills/tasks/<id>.json, and binds input_sha256 to a provided task-digest VALUE (the contract hash) rather than sha256 of a file. Extend factory/schemas/grill.json to accept gate=task plus a task_id field. The existing four gates (signoff/spec/epics/plan) are unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: record_grill_from_json.py accepts `--gate task --task <id>` and writes .factory/grills/tasks/<id>.json carrying verdict, gate=task, and task_id.
For the task gate, input_sha256 is bound to a supplied task-digest value (the contract hash), not sha256_of(a file).
factory/schemas/grill.json validates gate=task and a task_id field; the four existing gates behave exactly as before.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "task_grill or record_grill"
tasks.reviewer_focus: Per-id storage under grills/tasks/; digest bound to the task-digest value not a file; the four existing gates untouched; schema change is additive.

tasks.title: require_task_grill + delegation gate
tasks.objective: Add require_task_grill(root, task_id, expect_digest_value) in factory_lib.py as a task-keyed sibling of require_grill: resolve .factory/grills/tasks/<id>.json, require verdict==pass, a commit stamp, and input_sha256 == the task's task_digest. Insert it in cmd_delegate at the `if write:` point so a WRITE delegation is refused unless a fresh, digest-bound, passing per-task grill exists. Read-only lanes are unaffected.
acceptance_criteria: forge delegate <task> refuses a WRITE launch when no per-task grill exists, when its verdict is not pass, or when input_sha256 != task_digest(task) (stale); the refusal names the record command.
forge delegate <task> proceeds when a fresh, digest-bound, passing per-task grill exists.
A read-only delegation (write == False) is unaffected by the gate.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "require_task_grill or delegate_task_grill"
tasks.reviewer_focus: Gate fires only on write launches; stale (digest mismatch) is refused; read-only unaffected; refusal names the exact next command.

tasks.title: Board/UI: per-task grill status + done-story PR link
tasks.objective: Surface JIT provenance on the board. Extend board.py's grills read to also load .factory/grills/tasks/*.json, attach a grill field to each task's proof in task_dossiers, and render a grill line in taskDossier's proof block in index.html. Read pr-linked events (events.load_events(base, event='pr-linked')) and render the PR link on a done/shipped story. Extend factory/board/example/ so the render is demonstrable.
acceptance_criteria: story_detail/task_dossiers attach each task's per-task grill status from .factory/grills/tasks/<id>.json, and the task dossier renders a grill line beside Tests/Verify.
aggregate_state/story_detail resolve a done story's PR reference from pr-linked events, and a shipped story renders its PR link.
The board example fixture exercises both renders; existing board behaviour is otherwise unchanged.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "board"
tasks.reviewer_focus: grills glob now recurses into tasks/; task-grill status attached per task id; PR link read from pr-linked events; no board regression; example fixture demonstrates both.

tasks.title: Decision + docs: the JIT loop as contract
tasks.objective: Make the JIT loop the documented contract. Update WORKFLOW.md's gating model with the per-task grill gate and the author->re-record->grill->stage start->delegate loop; the /forge skill; factory/prompts/griller.md with a fifth `task` gate/scope; the docs-decomposer prompt to record the task LIST with contract detail deferred to JIT; and docs/degraded-mode.md with the manual per-task grill path. Decision 0032 is referenced.
acceptance_criteria: WORKFLOW.md gating model documents the per-task grill gate and the JIT loop (author -> re-record -> grill -> stage start -> delegate).
griller.md documents a fifth `task` gate/scope; the docs-decomposer prompt instructs recording the task LIST with per-task contract detail deferred to JIT.
The /forge skill and docs/degraded-mode.md cover the per-task grill step; decision 0032 is referenced.
tasks.reviewer_focus: Docs match the shipped gate exactly (no aspirational drift); griller/decomposer/skill/workflow/degraded-mode all name the task gate; 0032 referenced.
